messages.content: 一輛汽車從靜止開始，10秒內行駛了120公尺的距離。在這段時間結束時，汽車的速度是多少？在達到這個速度後，汽車繼續加速5秒，從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍。最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍。在第二階段，汽車的加速度是多少？

function.name: kinematics_calculate_acceleration
function.description: Calculates the acceleration of an object under given conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object. This is a float type value.

final_speed.description: The final speed of the object. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to reach the final speed. This is a float type value.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled. This is a float type value.

function.name: kinematics_calculate_speed_from_rest
function.description: Calculates the speed of an object that starts from rest under a constant acceleration over a specified distance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to travel. This is a float type value.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object. This is a float type value.

We need to compute first part: car starts from rest, covers 120 m in 10 s. We can assume constant acceleration? It says "from rest" but not explicitly constant acceleration; but likely constant acceleration. So we can use formula s = ut + 1/2 a t^2. u=0, s=120, t=10 => 120 = 0 + 0.5 a * 100 => 120 = 50 a => a = 120/50 = 2.4 m/s^2. Final speed v = u + a t = 0 + 2.4*10 = 24 m/s. So first part speed is 24 m/s.

Second part: after reaching this speed (24 m/s), car continues accelerating for 5 seconds, from 12 m/s to final speed which is twice the initial speed? Wait: "從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍". Then "汽車繼續加速5秒，從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍" means the car continues accelerating for 5 seconds, from 12 m/s to a final speed that is twice the initial speed. But then they say final speed is twice the speed from first part (which is 24 m/s). That would be 48 m/s. So maybe the phrase "從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍" actually means "from 12 m/s to a final speed that is twice the initial speed of the car" where initial speed refers to the speed at the start of the second stage? But that would be 12 m/s, so final speed 24 m/s. But then they say final speed is twice the speed from first part (24 m/s). So final speed 48 m/s. But we don't know final speed. They say final speed is twice the speed from first part: 48 m/s. So we can compute acceleration: a = (v - u)/t = (48 - 12)/5 = 36/5 = 7.2 m/s^2. So answer: acceleration 7.2 m/s^2.
